website_summary.name: Baseball Team Manager
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and user-friendly interface with floral white as the background and dark goldenrod for interactive elements, providing an engaging experience for managing and simulating baseball games.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist design with a navigation bar at the top offering options such as "Player Statistics," "Team Management," "Simulate Game," and "Game Results." The main content area displays player statistics in a well-organized table format, including columns for Name, Position, Batting Average, Home Runs, and RBIs. Below the table, there is a section for adding new players with input fields for Name and Position alongside an "Add Player" button. The overall layout uses floral white as the background color and dark goldenrod for buttons and other interactive elements, creating a visually appealing contrast.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to view detailed player statistics, add new players to the roster, manage teams, simulate games, and view game results. Users can interact with the site by clicking on navigation buttons to access different sections, entering data into input fields to add players, and initiating game simulations. The site also provides options for adjusting team strategies and lineups based on management decisions.
